subject: english
prompt: An email asks students to return tablets before Wednesday. Tuesday is the last school day before a two-day closure. When should a student return a tablet?

options.text: During the closure, when school is closed.
By Tuesday before the closure begins.
Any time Wednesday, because “before Wednesday” includes Wednesday.

answer.explanation: C before Wednesday 的最晚可辦理日是星期二；閉校前應在星期二離校前歸還。 Correct answer: C

solutionStrategy: 把截止用語「before Wednesday」轉成實際可辦理日期，再結合閉校日曆。
solutionSteps: 郵件要求 before Wednesday 歸還，表示星期三之前完成。
星期二是閉校前最後一個上課日。
因此應在星期二、學校閉校前歸還。
星期三不是 before Wednesday；閉校期間也無法到校；下個月更已過期。
答案 C；先翻譯期限詞，再查日曆上的實際工作日。
